info.description: Read-only answers about a Konstruct graph, from `konstruct serve`. Nodes are named by id in the routes that take `{id}`, `from` and `to`, and by any name the command line takes in the others. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details; the problem types are listed in `x-konstruct-problems`. When the server listens beyond this machine, every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
